daily.today_energy: The Moon in Aries is pushing you out of your comfort zone, but that restless energy is actually helpful. You're being asked to try something new instead of retreating into your shell. Trust that instinct.
daily.love: Venus in Libra is making you more thoughtful about relationships today. If you've been holding back a conversation, the vibe is supportive for honest talk. Your people want to hear what you're really thinking.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter is firing up ambition across the board, but you might feel it more as pressure than inspiration. Focus on one goal instead of spreading yourself thin. Quality over quantity always wins.
daily.health: With Saturn retrograde in Aries, old patterns around rest are coming up for review. You don't need to push harder right now—actually, ease off and prioritize sleep. Your body's asking for it.

weekly.overview: This week pulls you between introspection and action, Cancer. The Moon's journey from Pisces through Taurus into Gemini amplifies your emotional intelligence, while Mars conjunct Jupiter in Leo fires up your creative zone. Best Day: Thursday when the Full Moon hits—expect clarity and momentum. Watch Out: Sunday's Sun-Mars square might feel prickly; resist the urge to overcommit.
weekly.love: Early week, Venus sextile Jupiter sweetens romantic vibes—if you're coupled, vulnerability goes a long way. Singles? Put yourself out there; someone's paying attention. Midweek tensions ease as the Moon moves into Taurus, grounding your heart. By Friday, the Full Moon illuminates what you actually want versus what you think you should want. Trust that gut feeling.
weekly.career: The Sun-Jupiter square early week tests your ambition—don't shrink your ideas, just refine them. Midweek, Mars conjunct Jupiter energizes collaboration; this is your moment to pitch that project or ask for what you deserve. By week's end, Mercury in Scorpio helps you communicate with surgical precision. Someone's listening. This is your power move window.
weekly.health: The Moon trine Mars midweek gives you genuine energy—use it for movement, not burnout. Early week might feel foggy; hydrate and rest. As the Full Moon approaches Thursday, expect emotional release (journaling helps). Weekend: ground yourself with routine. Saturn retrograde reminds you that slow, consistent habits beat sprint-and-crash cycles.
